evidence: Plan §5 covariate (ii) — per-family base propensity on the TRAINING prompts ('the natural install-strength covariate', from one base-model gen+judge pass in P6) — is measured nowhere; the v2 install-covaried H3 read records only the stratum-constant eval-side propensity, so no within-stratum covaried r is possible post-hoc. Cheap to add before the P6 wave dispatches; impossible to match afterwards.
